steps.subject: Your Franklin Navigator business profile
steps.body:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

Franklin Navigator helps Franklin residents find and connect with local businesses and community resources.

We have a Franklin Navigator profile for your business:
View or claim your Franklin Navigator profile: {{Profile_URL}}

Claiming and managing your basic profile is free. No purchase is required.

If anything is wrong, you can request factual corrections or profile removal for free.

Community Membership is optional at $35/year, renewing annually until canceled. Its main benefit is helping increase your visibility in the Franklin community. It also lets you add more business details, services, hours, photos, website and contact links, and booking or quote links where available.

Questions? Reply to this email and we’ll be happy to help.

This is a commercial community-outreach email from Franklin Navigator.

notes: The sequence is initial + two normal follow-ups + one single re-engagement 90 calendar days after followup_2, then automatic outreach stops.
Follow-ups and re-engagement never send after a reply, unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, correction/removal request, organization/domain suppression, or other stop signal.
The active sending path remains Zoho direct SMTP/IMAP. Legacy provider runtimes remain disabled.
Every step BCCs reachrgnow@gmail.com through owner_bcc when used in the authorized production path.
Every message must retain a visible, isolated unsubscribe link plus RFC 8058 one-click headers, and open/click tracking remains off.
Every Community Membership mention leads with the primary benefit of helping increase visibility in the Franklin community; this is phrased as a benefit, not a guaranteed result.
This branch changes copy/timing only; it does not authorize or activate prospect sending or a volume increase.
